title: The Drowned Harbor
summary: Chapter II takes you beyond the archive. Explore a flooded harbor, make choices that change later encounters, and break the Tidekeeper’s hold.

sections.title: A journey with room to breathe
items: Ten stops include two exploration crossings, two lasting story decisions, route forks, and the Tidekeeper finale. Dash over gaps and restore the beacon’s two lenses.

Help the ferryman for healing lanterns and a memory, or take 35 ink and face an extra ambush. Drain later streets, or leave them flooded to break a boss anchor early. Every consequence is shown before you choose.

sections.title: Enemies that work together
items: Ink Menders heal their allies; interrupt the glowing link. Paper Leeches drain health and guard; strike them, retreat, or use cover to break the tether.
The Tidekeeper’s anchors reduce incoming damage by 60%. Break them, escape marked flood lanes, and interrupt the Menders it summons in its second phase.

sections.title: Bring something back
items: Three new memories and two keepsakes join your home. The beacon compass shortens ability cooldowns by 20%; the harbor lantern heals 8 health on the first defeat of an enemy in each wave.
Start either chapter from home. Chapter II begins with two gifts and 20 ink; memories and weapon mastery carry between journeys. Your choices stay in the route recap and checkpoint.

sections.title: Ready in your language
sections.paragraph: The chapter, new enemy journal entries, menus, and patch notes support all six website languages. Existing saves remain compatible. New choices are included in the bug report you can copy and share.

title: The Lost Drawing
summary: Rescue Rook, restore the road home, and return with a memory worth keeping. Update 2.3 introduces an authored first chapter and a home between attempts.

sections.title: A chapter with a purpose
items: Ten stops, branching routes, two minibosses, and a final duel with the Brute. Collect Rook’s three wing fragments and explore a vault with a hidden memory.
Cleared rooms open a visible doorway. The Brute’s second phase adds marked erasure lanes and a recovery window.

sections.title: A home between attempts
items: The quiet margin holds three memories and three keepsakes. Cut through enemies with a dash, unleash a perfect-block pulse, or fire an ink blade with your third swing.
Rescuing Rook and finishing the chapter unlock keepsakes for later attempts. Choose a keepsake at home; saved runs retain their original choice.

sections.title: Clearer combat, easier starts
items: Three new gifts change dashes, reflected shots, and combo finishers. The first reward offers these three distinct directions.
A sixth practical lesson teaches your active ability. Chapter objectives, optional guidance, attack symbols, and high-contrast outlines make the fight easier to follow.

sections.title: Your progress stays with you
sections.paragraph: Existing checkpoints, mastery, settings, and language choices are preserved. Find the original expedition, Boss Rush, and practice under Extras. New chapter text and patch notes support all six website languages. Bug reports now include recent game events and checkpoint details; nothing is sent automatically.

title: The Living Sketchbook
summary: Three chapters. New ways to fight. A book full of drawings worth finding. Update 2.2 makes the adventure bigger and gives you more ways to make it yours.

sections.title: Beyond the second page
items: The Torn Binding extends the adventure from eight to twelve stops. Face the Margin Knight, a new final boss with sword and shield stances.
Meet Crossblade, Needle Scribe, Shield Weaver, and Inkwright. Six new arena layouts add breakable cover, moving ink, and explosive barrels.
Six story events offer choices with visible costs and rewards. Rescue forgotten drawings or accept the hidden Palimpsest duel to earn its unique seal.

sections.title: Master your blade
items: Each weapon has an active ability. Lunge with Scrapsteel, smash the ground with Pagebreaker, or cast a flame fan with Emberbrand. Use Q by default, or the Ability touch button.
Three mastery challenges per weapon unlock an alternate finishing strike, an alternate ability, and a cosmetic scarf. Equip them in the Workshop for your next run.
Twenty-six gifts now include ability upgrades and new ways to combine your build. Your build page explains useful gift combinations.

sections.title: Play your way
items: Practice any enemy or boss phase with optional invincibility and visible ranges. Your adventure is preserved; practice grants no progression.
Boss Rush puts the three main bosses back to back. Start with three gifts, prepare between fights, and track a best time for each weapon.
Remap keyboard controls, use a standard controller, and choose touch control size and side. Weapon effects, enemy silhouettes, chapter scenery, and combat audio have been expanded.

sections.title: Keep your story
items: The Workshop tracks mastery, the journal remembers discovered enemies and rescued drawings, and recent history keeps your last ten completed attempts.
A copyable bug report includes the game version, seed, route, build, controls, and recent errors. Add what happened before sharing it; nothing is sent automatically.

Compatible 2.1 checkpoints continue into the longer adventure. Older clear records stay saved; twelve-stop adventure and Boss Rush records are tracked separately. Saves remain on this browser and device.

title: A small arcade. Six languages.
summary: WebyIsBored now welcomes players in English, German, French, Spanish, Romanian, and Russian. Choose your language from the dropdown and make yourself at home.

sections.title: Your language, across the arcade
sections.paragraph: The shared language selector translates the arcade, News, Coming Soon, and game menus, instructions, and story text. English remains the default. Your choice follows you between pages and is remembered on this browser.

sections.title: A website update
sections.paragraph: Language support belongs to the whole website. Future games can use the same shared system, and more languages can be added as the arcade grows.

title: Three blades. Two pages. Your adventure.
summary: The Adventure Update takes Line beyond the first page. Pick a weapon, choose where to fight and where to recover, spend your ink with Nib, and face the Ink Queen.

sections.title: Choose how you fight
items: Scrapsteel keeps a balanced three-hit combo, with gifts for faster swings and stronger perfect-block counters.
Pagebreaker trades speed for reach and impact. Its third strike breaks Warder shields; its signature gifts add a forward shockwave and a stronger finishing blow.
Emberbrand attacks quickly at close range and sets enemies alight. Develop longer burns or explosions when burning enemies fall.
Fourteen gifts: eight shared upgrades and two unique gifts for each weapon. Choices only offer gifts your weapon can use.

sections.title: A bigger journey
items: Eight stops across two chapters, with four forks that always move you forward. Choose regular or harder battles, then decide between Nib’s shop and free recovery.
Multi-wave fights, five arena layouts, cover, and floor ink that warns before it becomes dangerous. Harder routes earn more ink.
One currency: ink. Shop prices, health refills, and immediate effects are visible before buying. Each item can be bought once at that stop.
Short story moments with Line, the Margin, Nib, and the Ink Queen connect the journey.

sections.title: Learn the new enemies
items: Warders block blade hits from the front. Circle them, parry their slow swing, or break through with Pagebreaker’s third strike.
Blotters mark your location before dropping an ink pool. Leave the circle before it fills; floor ink cannot be blocked.
The Scribbled Brute guards the first page. The Ink Queen waits on the second, with quill fans, marked pools, radial volleys, and a second phase.

sections.title: A clearer fight, safer checkpoints
items: Guard now interrupts a swing immediately, including while holding Swing on touch. Touch guard aims toward nearby incoming shots, and Dash shows its recharge on the button.
Damage feedback names what hit you. A defeat explains whether an attack passed your guard, broke it, or came from unguardable floor ink.
Inspect your weapon and gifts during a pause or between encounters. The end-of-run summary includes combat time, enemies cleared, perfect blocks, retries, ink earned, and damage taken.

Route decisions, story stops, unchosen gifts, recovery stops, shop stock, and purchases save immediately. Combat resumes at the encounter entrance; retries restore that entrance without duplicating ink or gifts.

sections.title: Returning from 2.0
sections.paragraph: The Adventure uses a new checkpoint format, so unfinished 2.0 runs begin a fresh adventure. Your settings, completed tutorial, and First Page clear records are kept. Adventure records are tracked separately. Saves remain on this browser and device.

title: A fresh page. A whole new fight.
summary: Stick & Swing has been rebuilt around a simple idea: read the attack, make your move, and make every swing count. The First Page is a complete short run with four rooms and one boss.

sections.title: What’s new
items: A five-step playable tutorial for movement, sword combos, dashing, blocking, and perfect blocks. Practice is safe, and you can skip straight into a run.
A three-hit sword combo, optional hold-to-attack, clear enemy warnings, guard breaks, and reflected projectiles. Perfect blocks power up your next swing.
Three distinct enemies: the close-range Scrapper, charging Skitter, and ranged Spitter. Inkstones provide cover in the middle rooms.
The Scribbled Brute returns with charges, expanding shockwaves, projectile fans, and a faster second phase.
Choose a meaningful upgrade between rooms: longer reach, quicker dashes, a third-hit burst, stronger swings, more health, or healing perfect blocks.
Room checkpoints, saved reward choices, pause-on-focus-loss, touch controls with aim assist, and a reduced-effects setting.

sections.title: A new beginning
sections.paragraph: This release replaces the previous Story and Wave modes, shop, and equipment systems. Old saves are not compatible with the remake; your first visit starts a new run. The First Page is the first playable chapter. More chapters and weapon styles will follow as the game grows.

sections.title: A home for every update
sections.paragraph: News now has its own page, and future game slots have moved to Coming Soon. The arcade homepage is dedicated to games you can play today.

title: The arcade is open.
summary: WebyIsBored is now a home for a growing collection of browser games. Pick a game, jump in, and return to the arcade whenever you’re ready for something else.

sections.title: The starting lineup
sections.paragraph: Stick & Swing is our first playable game. Three clearly marked spaces are reserved for future games. More to play as we build them.
